column1: # Offline applications. Each is a container run by Podman inside its own user namespace,
# published on 127.0.0.1 only and reached through an Apache proxy that enforces the home-network rule.
# Columns, separated by single tabs: id, title, category, set, boot, scheme, proxies, memory limit,
#   set      nomad = part of Project NOMAD's catalogue; extra = an addition of this project;
#            retired = in NOMAD's catalogue but no longer maintained upstream, so never part of "all"
#   boot     auto = started at boot once added; manual = started on request (heavier applications)
#   proxies  LAN port > loopback port, comma separated; the first is the address people open; - for none
